newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle up $2 at $112/dressed - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle up $2 at $112/dressed - USDA.

text.p: Trading on slaughter steers and heifers very active, USDA said. Compared to last Thursday live sales $1.00-$2.00 higher; dressed basis $2.00 to mostly $3.00 higher. Demand and seller interest excellent all day. Many of the week's showlists now depleted.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered ( paid on hot carcass weights).
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1175-1325 lbs - 68.50-70.00; dressed basis 111.00-112.00; late mostly 112.00;
Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1225 lbs - 68.50-70.00; dressed basis 111.00-112.00; latest trades mostly 112.00; few early 110.00 ( weighted average 111.81).
Confirmed - 51,000 Last Week - 29,500 Last Year - 35,300 For week - 56,000 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 39,000 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 42,400
